definitions.explanation: One of the four divisions of the year (spring, summer, autumn, winter).

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{四|よっ}つ→四つ：03039_yottsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{季節|きせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{季節|きせつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦おいしくて→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{食|た}べています→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Fruit is delicious this season, and I eat it every day.
The flowers are beautiful this season and the weather is nice, so I like eating outside.

notes:
{季節|きせつ} refers to the seasons of the year.

The four seasons:
- ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧: spring
- ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧: summer
- ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧: autumn/fall
- ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧: winter

Common expressions:
- {季節|きせつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変|か}わり{目|め}→変わり目：12118_kawarime⟧: changing of the seasons
- {季節|きせつ}⟦{外|はず}れ→外れ：10487_hazure⟧: out of season
- ⟦{四季|しき}→四季：11809_shiki⟧: the four seasons (more literary)

Note: Japan's distinct four seasons are an important cultural concept, often referenced in literature, art, and daily conversation.
